**Is your feature request related to an ISO standard change?**
If so, please link to the relevant change document or ISO publication.

**Describe the current behaviour and what you'd like instead**
A clear and concise description of what currently happens and what you expected/wanted to see instead.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered, and why they don't work for you.

**Why would this be useful to most nv-i18n users?**
Explain the benefit to the wider user base rather than just your own use case. If this only affects a small subset of
users, consider whether it's better suited to your own add-on library.
